implemented_requirements.requirement: Card representation with rank, suit, ordering, and display
implemented_requirements.evidence: card.py defines Card class, validates rank, provides ordering via __lt__, __eq__, and display property.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Deck creation, shuffling and dealing (17 cards each + 3 bottom cards)
implemented_requirements.evidence: deck.py implements create_deck() and deal() returning three hands and bottom cards.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Combination detection for all standard Dou Dizhu types
implemented_requirements.evidence: combination.py defines detect(cards) handling singles, pairs, triples, bombs, rockets, straights, pair straights, airplanes, and several winged forms.
The file mentions a beats(other) method in the docstring but no such method is implemented; no comparison logic beyond detection.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Bidding phase to determine the landlord
implemented_requirements.evidence: No code related to bidding, landlord selection, or handling of bottom cards is present.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Game loop for three players, enforcing turn order and pass/beat logic
implemented_requirements.evidence: There is no game controller, player classes, or turn management.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Integration of bottom cards into landlord's hand after winning the bid
implemented_requirements.evidence: Bottom cards are dealt but never assigned to any player.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Winning condition detection (first to run out of cards)
implemented_requirements.evidence: No logic to track hand sizes or declare a winner.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Executable entry point or test harness
implemented_requirements.evidence: No __main__ block, no CLI or UI, and missing functions referenced (e.g., _detect_airplane_wings).

critical_issues: Missing implementation of beats/comparison logic for combinations; the benchmark requires pass-or-beat enforcement.
No bidding phase or landlord determination code; the core game flow cannot start.
Reference to undefined function _detect_airplane_wings causing runtime errors.
Absence of player management, turn order, and win condition handling.
No executable script or entry point; the repository cannot be run as a game.
judge.summary: The repository provides low‑level building blocks (Card class, deck creation, and a fairly complete combination detector) but lacks the majority of the required game mechanics: bidding, landlord assignment, turn handling, pass-or-beat logic, and win detection. Critical functions are missing or undefined, making the code non‑executable as a Dou Dizhu game. Consequently, the submission fails the benchmark.
